name: convoy
description: Orchestrate multiple AI coding harnesses as neurons on one durable Convoy thread.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate your AI coding agents on one inspectable thread.
interface.longDescription: Convoy connects Codex to a shared, durable thread for discovering available harnesses, forming multi-agent crews, routing work, and verifying acknowledgements. Its bundled skill fails closed when the configured MCP endpoint does not expose the capabilities a requested workflow needs.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this endpoint can create a crew.
